parked_for: B1 feeling adjectives whose cause form is not -ing. Do not invent a node until James asks.
why: Patrik: *I was really stressful*. Same job as bored/boring (person feels vs thing causes) but a different ending: stressed / stressful, not *stressing*. One -ful pair inside an -ed/-ing drill is an odd one out. Cut from A2. Not b1_suffixes (that is CARE → careful = full of). Not b2_word_formation (FCE derivation, success → successful).

items.cz: V práci jsem byl ve stresu.
items.explanation: **stressed** = how I feel. The cause is **stressful**, not *stressing*.
items.explanation_cz: **stressed** = jak se cítím. Příčina je **stressful**, ne *stressing*.

items.explanation: **stressful** = the exam causes the feeling. Not *stressing*. I was **stressed**.
items.explanation_cz: **stressful** = zkouška ten pocit způsobuje. Ne *stressing*. Já jsem byl **stressed**.

points: Some cause adjectives take another ending.
